card.name: Multiplier words and decimal points after numbers
card.fires_on: Responds to the word 'times' or '-fold' right after a number as a multiplier, and to the decimal point inside a number such as 6.4 or 4.37. It appears in clinical and scientific numeric results.

modes.label: Multiplier after number
modes.description: 'times' or '-fold' directly after a number, stating how many times higher something is.
modes.example: risk of developing breast cancer is about 20<< times>> higher than in otherwise healthy men.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The decimal point after a single digit in a measured value, ratio or statistic.
modes.example: The best-known of which is the iron feature around 6<<.>>4 keV.
